feed.title: Bartosz: recently pushed projects
feed.subtitle: One entry per project, renewed whenever it is pushed to. Source for all of them: https://github.com/bmmmm

entry.title: pegel-visual — live ASCII water levels for German rivers, with an optional aircraft overlay from your own ADS-B receiver.
entry.summary: live ASCII water levels for German rivers, with an optional aircraft overlay from your own ADS-B receiver.
entry.content: Live ASCII water levels for German rivers, straight from PEGELONLINE, with an optional aircraft overlay fed by your own ADS-B receiver. A dashboard that fits in an 80×24 terminal and still tells you whether the river is rising.

entry.title: comparereleaseii — fact-check release notes against the diff that shipped — GitHub, Forgejo, GitLab or any git clone.
entry.summary: fact-check release notes against the diff that shipped — GitHub, Forgejo, GitLab or any git clone.
entry.content: Fact-checks release notes against the diff that shipped. Works on GitHub, Forgejo, GitLab or any local git clone. Answers the question you have before an upgrade: does the changelog describe what changed, and what did it leave out?

entry.title: gymii — floor-plan your gym, log sets against numbered machines. Offline-first, data never leaves the device.
entry.summary: floor-plan your gym, log sets against numbered machines. Offline-first, data never leaves the device.
entry.content: Floor-plan your gym, then log sets against numbered machines instead of guessing which bench you used. Offline-first, all data in the browser.

entry.title: ClickHistory — keeps a history of the article links you actually opened.
entry.summary: keeps a history of the article links you actually opened.
entry.content: Keeps a history of the article links you actually opened, as opposed to the ones you scrolled past. Turns "I read something about this last month" into a searchable list.

entry.title: ShareViaQRCode — a large QR code for the current article, so a phone can pick the link off the screen.
entry.summary: a large QR code for the current article, so a phone can pick the link off the screen.
entry.content: Shows a large QR code for the current article, so a phone can pick the link straight off the screen — no sharing service in between.

entry.title: claudii — statusline for Claude Code: session cost, context %, rate limits, model health. Pure bash + jq, zero daemons.
entry.summary: statusline for Claude Code: session cost, context %, rate limits, model health. Pure bash + jq, zero daemons.
entry.content: A statusline for Claude Code: session cost, context usage in percent, rate-limit headroom and model health, refreshed in the prompt. Pure bash and jq — no daemon, no background process, nothing that outlives the shell.

entry.title: how-small-can-we-go — trust-golf: one champion per task, dethroned by needing less trust. Measured, never claimed.
entry.summary: trust-golf: one champion per task, dethroned by needing less trust. Measured, never claimed.
entry.content: A trust-golf arena: one champion per task, dethroned by needing less trust — fewer third-party bytes, fewer dangerous constructs. Every entry is measured against the same surface metric, never self-declared, and the current champion is whoever survived the last challenge.

entry.title: NoteDrop — drop notes and links on one device, copy them on another with one click.
entry.summary: drop notes and links on one device, copy them on another with one click.
entry.content: Drop notes and links from one device and copy them on another with one click — the gap between reading on the phone and acting on the laptop, closed without a chat message to yourself.

entry.title: musiclinkii — turn one music link into links for every streaming platform.
entry.summary: turn one music link into links for every streaming platform.
entry.content: Turn one music link into links for every streaming platform, so a recommendation stops depending on what the other person subscribes to. Fully static.

entry.title: db-wallet — drink tracking wallet for the crowd at bitcircus101.de and Datenburg e.V. Bonn.
entry.summary: drink tracking wallet for the crowd at bitcircus101.de and Datenburg e.V. Bonn.
entry.content: Drink tracking wallet for the crowd at bitcircus101.de and Datenburg e.V. Bonn.

entry.title: shieldchipiii — stone-chip logbook for your windshield, so the insurance conversation has a record instead of a memory.
entry.summary: stone-chip logbook for your windshield, so the insurance conversation has a record instead of a memory.
entry.content: A stone-chip logbook for your car windshield: photograph and date every chip, so the insurance conversation later has a record instead of a memory. Local-only web app plus a terminal CLI, DE/EN.

entry.title: kuvertii — read what an email header says about you — who it was really addressed to, where the unsubscribe link leads.
entry.summary: read what an email header says about you — who it was really addressed to, where the unsubscribe link leads.
entry.content: Paste an email header and read what it says about you: who the message was really addressed to, how that address was hidden from the other recipients, and where the unsubscribe link actually leads. Runs entirely client-side — a tool about privacy that uploaded your mail headers would be a joke.

entry.title: epcii — EPC QR code (GiroCode) generator — one static binary with its own QR encoder core.
entry.summary: EPC QR code (GiroCode) generator — one static binary with its own QR encoder core.
entry.content: EPC QR code (GiroCode) generator — a single static binary with its own QR encoder core rather than a dependency tree, so a payment code can be generated on a machine you do not want to install anything on.

entry.title: ExitReaderView — a floating button to leave the reading view in one click.
entry.summary: a floating button to leave the reading view in one click.
entry.content: Adds a floating button to leave the reading view in one click. Nine commits, and it fixes the thing that annoyed me daily.

entry.title: putzii — cleaning schedule shared by capability link, with QR check-in. No backend at all.
entry.summary: cleaning schedule shared by capability link, with QR check-in. No backend at all.
entry.content: A cleaning schedule for a shared flat or office, handed around as a capability link and checked in by QR code on the wall. No accounts, no backend — the link is the permission.

entry.title: git-times-live — a standalone live broadcast TV channel for your git activity.
entry.summary: a standalone live broadcast TV channel for your git activity.
entry.content: A standalone live broadcast TV channel for your git activity, generated from git-times. Exactly as useful as it sounds, and it runs.

entry.title: app-icons-generator — every iOS, macOS and watchOS icon size from one 1024px PNG — CLI and browser.
entry.summary: every iOS, macOS and watchOS icon size from one 1024px PNG — CLI and browser.
entry.content: Generates every iOS, macOS and watchOS app icon size from one 1024px PNG. Available as a CLI and as a client-side browser tool — the browser version never uploads the image.
